items.title: The Price of Cheap Writes: How does RocksDB read?
items.summary: RocksDB reads newest to oldest, stopping at the first version it finds. Learn how bloom filters, the block cache, and prefix seeks keep that search fast.

items.summary: SkyAI holds $223.8 million in cash after selling all its SOL, with its $3 buyback running through Oct. 29.

items.title: Geo-Aware Leader Schedule
items.summary: This study evaluates SIMD-0675, a geo-aware leader schedule for Solana. It reorders the stake-weighted random schedule so that consecutive leaders are geographically close, which cuts handoff latency. No validator’s number of leader windows changes. Two parameters are tuned: STAK
